title: "Edges only" switch is a link with role=switch: Space does not toggle it, it reloads the page [4.1.2 Name, Role, Value]
expected: A role=switch toggles with Space (and Enter) in place and announces the new state without a full navigation.
actual: It is <a role="switch" aria-checked="false" href="/slate?sport=nba&edges=1">. Space does nothing (URL unchanged); only Enter, as for a link, navigates to a new URL. aria-checked is correct after reload, but the control is a navigation link, so assistive tech users get switch semantics with link behaviour.
evidence: Playwright: after Space url unchanged; after Enter url ...&edges=1
suspected_area: app/src/app/slate/page.tsx line ~46. Fix: use a real button/checkbox with a form GET, or drop role=switch and use aria-pressed/current on a link
